Hi Alex —

I work on the SDR team at Redwood Inference. Congrats — your BrightOps trial just crossed the high-usage threshold we watch for (you’ve been ramping token volume this week). Often a short 20-minute walkthrough helps teams optimize configs (batching, cache, model variant) and avoid early throttles.

Would you be open to a 20-minute session to:
- review the usage pattern we’re seeing,
- point out low-effort config changes to lower unit cost, and
- go over a quick checklist so you can self-serve confidently?

I’m available:
- Wed 2/14: 11:00–11:30 PST
- Wed 2/14: 13:00–13:30 PST
- Thu 2/15: 09:00–09:30 PST

If none of those work, tell me two windows that do and I’ll get it on the calendar. I’ve attached a one-page usage snapshot so you can see the spike we’re referencing.

Thanks —
